description_short: Group thermal ALE chemistries from Fang et al. Table 3 into inferred mechanistic archetypes and compute, for each group, the number of distinct materials and the mean EPC.

paper.title: Thermal atomic layer etching: Mechanism, materials and prospects

tables_modeled.label: Table 3
tables_modeled.description: Summary of thermal ALE processes: etched material, surface-adsorption and surface-removal reactants, etch-per-cycle (EPC), and etching temperature.

comparisons.table_source: Fang et al. (2018), Thermal ALE Table 3

properties_used.label: Material
properties_used.role: Identifies the solid being etched in the thermal ALE process (e.g., SiO2, Al2O3, Si3N4).

properties_used.label: Surface adsorption reactant
properties_used.role: Reactant responsible for the initial surface modification or adsorption step in the ALE cycle.

properties_used.label: Surface removal reactant
properties_used.role: Reactant that removes the modified surface layer, typically via volatile products.

properties_used.label: Etch per cycle (EPC)
properties_used.role: Etch-per-cycle value in Å/cycle; used here to compare etch-rate efficiency across mechanistic archetypes.

numeric_parsing.strategy: Extract the first numeric token from EPC strings that may contain ranges or multiple values, using a regex capture and casting to xsd:decimal.
numeric_parsing.caveats: For multi-valued or range EPC entries, only one representative number is used; more refined analysis of ranges would require separate handling.

mechanism_buckets.description: Mechanistic archetypes are inferred from keyword patterns over adsorption and removal reactants.
buckets: Fluorination + ligand-exchange: HF combined with TMA, DMAC, Sn(acac)2, Al(CH3)2Cl, or SiCl4.
Halogenation + conversion: WF6 combined with BCl3.
Oxidation + fluorination: O2 or O3 together with HF.
Other: all chemistries not matching the above patterns.
mechanism_buckets.note: The classification is heuristic and intended for high-level grouping rather than a fully detailed mechanistic assignment.

output_shape.description: One row per inferred mechanism archetype.
columns: n_materials: number of distinct etched materials in this family.
avg_epc: average etch-per-cycle (Å/cycle) over chemistries in this family.

postprocessing_notes.interpretation: The result supports cross-material comparison of etch-rate efficiency within broadly defined reaction families, helping identify which mechanistic archetypes tend to deliver higher EPC across the thermal ALE landscape summarized in Fang et al. Table 3.
